What does it take to make AI truly transformative? Not just technological breakthroughs, but solutions that address real-world challenges and create meaningful impact.
The Mint All About AI Tech4Good Awards 2026 brought together innovators, industry leaders, policymakers and changemakers to recognise how artificial intelligence is being harnessed for social good.
From sustainability, agriculture and healthcare to education, financial inclusion, accessibility and responsible AI, the awards celebrated ideas and innovations that are pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
